artifact.appearance: blue idol/vase icon; also the blue hexagon at bottom-right of artifact cards

item.appearance: brown crate/rope frame with red arrowhead; bottom-right corner of item cards; also inline in text

exile_card.appearance: card icon with a big red X

discard_card.appearance: dark card with yellow curved arrow

refresh_assistant.appearance: card with dark silhouette on a grey/yellow base and a brown curved arrow

bottom_draw.appearance: card with green plus on a grey base and a brown curved arrow

instant.appearance: black lightning bolt at the start of an effect row

arrow_next.appearance: dark triangle separating input from result

discount_buy_item.appearance: item card icon with a red minus and 2 coins: buy an item with a discount of 2

discount_buy_artifact.appearance: artifact card icon with a red minus and 2 compasses: buy an artifact with a discount of 2

cards.name: Brush
cards.effect_text: Gain {compass} for each {artifact} you have, up to 3.

cards.name: Cursed Coin
cards.effect_text:
{coin}{coin}
You may take 1 {fear_card} card from your play area into your hand.

cards.name: Whip
cards.effect_text: Exile this card to buy {artifact} with a discount of {compass}{compass}{compass}{compass}.

cards.name: Shovel
cards.effect_text: Buy {artifact} with a discount of {compass}{compass} and exile it after resolving its effect.

cards.name: Precision Compass
cards.effect_text: Buy {artifact} with a discount of {compass}{compass}{compass}, include the top card of the artifact deck.

cards.name: Spectacles
cards.effect_text:
{compass}{tablet}
You may buy artifacts from the exile pile this round.

cards.name: Improvised Weapon
Thoughtful Gift
cards.effect_text: Exile this card and {discard_card} to gain {item} to your hand.

cards.name: First Aid Kit
cards.effect_text: Look at the top 4 cards of your deck. Either exile up to 2, or keep 1. Return the rest in any order.

cards.name: Fishing Rod
cards.effect_text: Buy {item} with a discount of {coin}{coin}{coin}, include the top card of the item deck.

cards.name: Airdrop
cards.effect_text: Exile this card to gain {item} to your hand.

cards.effect_text:
Exile a card from the card row and refill it.
{discount_buy_item} / {discount_buy_artifact}

cards.effect_text: Use the effect of any {item} from the card row. (If that {item} says to exile it, exile Tool Box instead.)

cards.name: Landing Net
cards.effect_text:
{instant}{coin}{coin}
For the rest of this round, whenever you buy {item} you may put it on top of your deck.

cards.name: Large Backpack
cards.effect_text:
{coin}
Draw a card from the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Little Monkey
cards.effect_text:
{instant}{coin}{coin}

cards.name: Ornate Hammer
cards.effect_text: Exile the rightmost {item} in the card row. Gain any {item} from exile to the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Mantle of Dusk
cards.effect_text: If you have no cards in your hand, then {draw_card}{draw_card}. Otherwise gain {gem}.

cards.effect_text:
{assistant_grey}{check_green} {assistant_yellow}{check_green}

cards.name: Stone Calendar
cards.effect_text:
<some action>
You may pass to start next round with 1 additional card.

cards.name: Dark Statuette
cards.effect_text: Look at your entire deck. Return all {fear_card} cards. Then keep up to 2 and {discard_card} the rest.

cards.name: Decorated Horn
cards.effect_text: Exchange one of your {assistant} with one available on the supply board. The new one is the same level and refreshed.

cards.name: Cape of Dawn
cards.effect_text: If there is no other card in your play area, then {draw_card}{draw_card}. Otherwise {coin}{coin}{coin}.

{draw_card}{draw_card}

Draw up to 2 cards from the bottom of your deck.

cards.name: Coconut Flask
